confirmation_protocol_if_screen_passes.residual_training: Apr15-21 using frozen base scores trained on Apr8-14
confirmation_protocol_if_screen_passes.base_refit: Apr8-21 with the same fixed four epochs
confirmation_protocol_if_screen_passes.selected_differential_weight: locked from screen and never retuned

promotion_rule: overall champion residual must strictly improve primary, GAUC, and nDCG@5 and no metric may regress in any of four user folds
